sentences.text: This blue whale was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Blue whales are the largest animals known to have lived.
Blue whales in the eastern North Pacific feed off California in summer and autumn and move south for the winter.
On {farthest_date} this one was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began, as far south as {southernmost_lat} at its southernmost.
